news.title: mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory allocator for the modern era
news.summary_raw:
mimalloc is an open-source, modern, scalable memory allocator that is a drop-in replacement for malloc and free. It is relatively small (~12K lines), with clear internal data structures, and is easy to build and integrate into other projects. It provides bounded worst-case allocation times (up to OS primitives), bounded space overhead, low internal fragmentation, and minimal contention by relying almost exclusively on atomic operations.
The post mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory
news.summary: Microsoft Research has released mimalloc, an open-source, high-performance memory allocator as a drop-in replacement for malloc and free. This scalable allocator offers efficient allocation and low fragmentation for modern systems.
news.enterprise_use: While mimalloc is not directly applicable to IT infrastructure, it provides a valuable example of scalable memory management. This highlights the importance of efficient resource utilization for complex systems, and IT engineers managing endpoint security and access control should note this development.
